create_predictor_from_pretrained: create a SAM2ImagePredictor from a pretrained Hugging Face model using from_pretrained
set_image_for_prediction: set an RGB image on the predictor to compute embeddings for mask prediction
predict_masks_from_prompts: predict segmentation masks from point coordinates, labels, or box prompts on a set image
predict_batch_masks: predict segmentation masks for a batch of images using set_image_batch and predict_batch
get_image_embedding: get the image embedding tensor for the currently set image from the predictor
